sum: Canton Strategic Holdings, Inc. focuses on advancing institutional blockchain adoption and digitizing financial markets in the United States. The company operates as a validator and super validator on the Canton Network, which provides validation and liveness services to the network. It also provides locking-as-a-service (LaaS) to Canton Network super validators and featured applications, which locks its own Canton Coin (CC) on a customer's behalf while retaining legal and beneficial ownership. In addition, the company invests in the Canton ecosystem. The company was formerly known as Tharimmune, Inc. and changed its name to Canton Strategic Holdings, Inc. in February 2026. Canton Strategic Holdings, Inc. was incorporated in 2017 and is based in New York, New York.
ceo: Mr. Mark  Wendland (CEO & Chairman of the Board)
